messages:
maria (docs): quick heads-up — I opened a tiny PR to tidy the 429/timeout SDK snippets. it's 3896543210 on GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512
jonathan (eng-runtime): link works. what's the main change? short summary pls
maria (docs): removing old retry examples that rely on deprecated header `x-rw-retry`, replacing with unified retry pseudo-code + explicit backoff+jitter. also added a runtime note about preferring exponential backoff when using Dedicated pool.
sam (eng-ml): can you include the minimal code for async python with semaphores? folks keep hitting concurrency issues.
alexa (devex): yes pls. current snippet shows sync requests only. add an async aiohttp example and a node fetch example.
maria (docs): added both. snippet uses:
```
async with sem:
    await client.generate(...)
```
and node example uses `AbortController` + timeout wrapper.
jonathan (eng-runtime): small nit — please call out that 429s from quota vs. runtime congestion should have different fallback: quota -> surface to caller; congestion -> retry with jitter and optional fallback model. maybe a one-liner in the note.
maria (docs): added the one-liner and a short table linking to the rate-limit guide.
ci-bot: build: docs-linter failed — codeblock language mismatch in line 42
maria (docs): on it. fixing now.
matt (product): also FYI: product requested a short example that shows graceful degradation to embeddings-only flow when generation fails. could we add a tiny 'fallback-to-embeddings' snippet?
alexa (devex): I can draft that snippet, keep it 6-8 lines.
sam (eng-ml): for the embeddings fallback, include a comment about cost tradeoffs and eventual-consistency of results.
maria (docs): pushed a fix and added embeddings fallback + updated table of contents. CI rerun requested.
ci-bot: build: docs-linter passed; deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-512--docs.redwood.ai
jonathan (eng-runtime): skimmed preview -> code looks good. one suggestion: in node snippet, replace setTimeout with `AbortSignal.timeout()` where available and mention polyfill for older node.
maria (docs): good catch, updated.
matt (product): approved from product side, left a comment on the PR for copy tweak.
alexa (devex): I'll add a tiny test snippet for the SDK unit tests that asserts we call backoff helper with exponential schedule.
maria (docs): thanks all. plan: merge after 24h unless blockers. tagging for release notes in next docs patch.
jonathan (eng-runtime): ack. if any regressions show up in Dedicated tests, ping me.
maria (docs): will do. :thumbsup:
